EXTENSION NOTICE
It is notified for the information of all the concerned that the date for submission of online
application forms for the post of Deputy Registrar/Deputy Controller of Examinations,
Director, South Campus, Convocation Complex, DIQA & IOT Zakura Campus advertised

for 10 days w.e.f. 03.11.2023 to 12.11.2023.
